boundary: Owned network-none source build. Five independent production Fleet web/settings/join/member services per mass wave, no Agent lifecycle or backend CLI. Remaining clients use shipped compiled join/member code and explicit harness-side durable profiles. Synthetic LDAP; owned HTTPS proxies; deliberate eligibility-delay control for real admission backpressure. Not packaged/systemd/native/pilot/real AD.
